name: Recordly
one_liner: Turns a screen recording into a polished demo video without editing.

text.why: A product demo takes longer to edit than it does to record. recordly is built so that no editing skill is required: finish the recording and what comes out is already presentable. It is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, and the repository describes it as free. GitHub shows no license field, but the README states AGPL 3.0.
text.take: Built to remove the editing pass after recording, so it suits anyone who records demos often.
build: Internal how-to clips recorded whenever a feature changes
